# Traycer HTTP API

> Traycer provisions blockchain wallets on Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, and Tron for your users, reads live on-chain balances, prices and broadcasts transfers, and pushes webhook events when funds move. Every wallet is addressed by an identifier you choose (`walletReference`), so you never store Traycer identifiers.

Base URL: `https://your-domain.com/api/v1/http` (placeholder — substitute your deployed host). Local default: `http://localhost:6969/api/v1/http`.

Authentication: `x-api-key: trc_live_<prefix>_<secret>` on every request. Keys are scoped `read` or `read_write`.

Response envelope, on success and failure alike: `{ "message": string, "code": number, "data": object|null }`. Validation failures add `validationErrors: [{ path, message }]`.

Critical facts an integrator must know:
- Token transfers are paid for in the chain's native currency. A wallet holding only USDT cannot send USDT — it needs TRX/ETH/BNB for gas. Always call `POST /transfers/quote` first and read `isSufficient`.
- `POST /transfers` returning `201` means **broadcast**, not confirmed, and blockchain transfers are irreversible.
- Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on `POST /transfers`. A retry with the same key replays the original response instead of sending twice.
- Missing resources return `400` with a validation error, not `404` — existence is checked during request validation.
- Webhooks are delivered **once**, with no retry, and time out after 10 seconds. Reconcile against `GET /transactions`.
- Deposit/withdrawal indexing currently runs on **Tron only**. Other chains support wallets, balances, quotes, and sends, but their transactions are not indexed and fire no webhooks.
- Rate limit in production: 60 requests per minute per IP. `429` responses do not use the standard envelope.

- [Quickstart](/guides/quickstart.mdx): Wallet to completed payout in five requests, with Node and Python versions.

## Core concepts

- [Wallets](/guides/wallets.mdx): `walletReference` rules, the `network` vs `walletChain` distinction, active/inactive status, and private key handling.
- [Networks and assets](/guides/networks-and-assets.mdx): Supported chains and tokens, the gas rule, per-chain fee mechanics, balance keys per network, and mainnet vs testnet chain IDs.
- [Transfers](/guides/transfers.mdx): The quote-then-send flow, what happens before broadcasting, every rejection case, and how a broadcast becomes a ledger row.
- [Idempotency](/guides/idempotency.mdx): The four outcomes of an `Idempotency-Key`, how to choose keys, and a correct retry loop.
- [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks.mdx): Event payloads, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification in Node/Python/Go, delivery semantics, and reconciliation.

- [Responses and errors](/guides/errors.mdx): The envelope, every status code, common validation messages, and a typed client.
- [Pagination and filtering](/guides/pagination.mdx): Offset pagination, per-endpoint filters, and the differing row keys and field names between the two transaction endpoints.

## API reference

- [API reference overview](/api-reference/introduction.mdx): Base URL, conventions, and the endpoint index.
- [List networks](/api-reference/networks/list-networks.mdx): `GET /networks` — active networks and their coins. Scope `read`.
- [Create wallet](/api-reference/wallets/create-wallet.mdx): `POST /wallets` — provision an address. Scope `read_write`.
- [List wallets](/api-reference/wallets/list-wallets.mdx): `GET /wallets` — paginated, with search/network/status filters. Scope `read`.
- [Get wallet](/api-reference/wallets/get-wallet.mdx): `GET /wallets/{walletReference}`. Scope `read`.
- [Update wallet status](/api-reference/wallets/update-wallet.mdx): `PATCH /wallets/{walletReference}` — active/inactive. Scope `read_write`.
- [Get balances](/api-reference/wallets/get-balances.mdx): `GET /wallets/{walletReference}/balances` — live from chain. Scope `read`.
- [List wallet transactions](/api-reference/wallets/list-wallet-transactions.mdx): `GET /wallets/{walletReference}/transactions`. Scope `read`.
- [Quote a transfer](/api-reference/transfers/quote-transfer.mdx): `POST /transfers/quote` — fee estimate and sufficiency check. Scope `read`.
- [Send a transfer](/api-reference/transfers/send-transfer.mdx): `POST /transfers` — sign and broadcast. Scope `read_write`.
- [Get transfer](/api-reference/transfers/get-transfer.mdx): `GET /transfers/{txHash}`. Scope `read`.
- [List transactions](/api-reference/transactions/list-transactions.mdx): `GET /transactions` — organization-wide ledger. Scope `read`.
- [Create subscription](/api-reference/webhooks/create-subscription.mdx): `POST /webhooks/subscriptions`. Scope `read_write`.
- [List subscriptions](/api-reference/webhooks/list-subscriptions.mdx): `GET /webhooks/subscriptions`. Scope `read`.
- [Delete subscription](/api-reference/webhooks/delete-subscription.mdx): `DELETE /webhooks/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}`. Scope `read_write`.
- [Rotate signing secret](/api-reference/webhooks/rotate-secret.mdx): `POST /webhooks/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/rotate-secret`. Scope `read_write`.
